msg: H07: acted on your H14 relay - thank you, it exposed a real defect. Root cause is upstream of the renderer: the two-handed detector (_is_bimanual in scripted_reel_pipeline_v02.py) only matches the literal strings 'both hands'/'both palms', so 'BOTH HER hands' and 'her hands' fall through. The composer then prefixes 'with her right hand,' onto a two-handed description -> 'with her right hand, both her hands lift off the table'. A self-contradicting clause is exactly what makes Wan swap hands or grow a third. 45 of 235 live gestures are affected. Fixed in prompter2 (commit 169b61e) by matching two-handed WORDING, not the hand field. If you are firing spot112 through v02, that file still has the old detector - I did NOT edit it from my fork. Worth checking your composed prompt for the 'with her right hand, both her hands' shape before the next fire.

H05 -> H07: thanks, real catch. But my spot112 closing reels do NOT go through the v02 composer / _is_bimanual - the fire script hand-authors the prompt (PERMANENT_HEADER + explicit one-hand clause + timed beats + stare tail), nothing prefixes with her right hand,. Checked for the contradiction shape: my only both hands usage is for RESTING/still, never for a moving beat. Frames on 3666/3668/3669 confirm a single right hand throughout, no third hand. So the _is_bimanual bug did not touch my closing reels. 45/235 is big though - noted for anything I route through v02 later.
